steps.title: Getting started
steps.text: Talk to Maria north of the Archaeology Campus.

Enter the mansion.
  • IMPORTANT: If you go in and out of a room to dodge the ghost, you have to manually go back a step.
Pick up the raven key and clock hands.

steps.title: Repairing grandfather clock and organising books
steps.text: Use the clock hands on the grandfather clock.
Repeat only: Open and search the chest (10).

Sort the pile of books.
  • First pick any random order of books.
  • The order is from bottom to top.
  • Use the hints to find the correct order.
Take the fourth eye gem from the table.

steps.title: Getting spider key
steps.text: Repeat only: Open and search the chest (20).
Open SOUTH door to the upstairs lobby (unbolt).

steps.title: Getting scythe key
steps.text: Take the eye gem on the floor.
Investigate the statue twice. Progress all dialogue.
Investigate the statue twice. Progress all dialogue.
Investigate the statue twice. Progress all dialogue.
Take the scythe key on the floor.

steps.title: Getting skull key
steps.text:
Investigate the shrine.
  • Search the chest for food.
Search the scorched skeleton in SOUTH-EAST corner for an eye gem.
Turn run OFF. Follow the path while dodging the flying knives.
Use the large pipette on the pig.

postconditions.text: You received the Large pipette of pig bile!

steps.text: Use the pipette of pig bile on the cauldron.
Use the human ashes on the cauldron.
Use the large pipette on the cauldron.
Use the alkaline concoction on the SOUTH door.

postconditions.text: You dissolved the ectoplasm with the alkaline concoction!

steps.title: Getting tusks key
steps.text:
Repeat only:
  • Open SOUTH-EAST door.
  • Open and search the chest (40).
  • Open WEST door.

steps.title: Heading to shrine of the son

steps.text: Investigate the statue twice. Progress all dialogue.

steps.title: Taking back mother's hairbrush
steps.text: Take from the shrine of the son.

Move the body.
  • Eat food if need be.

steps.title: Going through long corridor
steps.text: Open and climb into the cupboard.
Peek through peephole along the wall.

steps.title: Getting to the ancient door puzzle
steps.text:
Repeat only:
  • Open SOUTH-EAST door.
  • Open and search the chest (30).
  • Open WEST door.

Optional safe room:
  • Open NORTH-WEST door.
  • Search the chest for food.
  • Open SOUTH door.

steps.title: Solving ancient door puzzle
steps.text: Move all statues EXCEPT the north statue.
Stand on the MIDDLE yellow pressure plate.
Descend the stairs behind the ancient door.

steps.title: Climbing down the well
steps.text: Repeat only: Open and search the chest (50).

steps.title: Getting dagger key
steps.text: Repeat only: Open and search the chest (60).

Open EAST door.
  • Search NORTH chest for food.
Repeat only: Open and search the chest (70).
Repeat only: Open and search the chest (80).

steps.title: Back to grandfather clock
steps.text:
Optional safe room:
  • Open NORTH-WEST door.
  • Search the chest for food.
  • Open SOUTH door.

steps.title: Dialogue with Ormod
steps.text:
Repeat only:
  • Open EAST door.
  • Open and search the chest (90).
  • Open WEST door.
Use the scroll on the monster.
